summaryForNext: Two root causes confirmed: (1) gateway-log written to /tmp/ but workflow reads workspace root — one-line copy fix; (2) MEDIA_ADVERTISE_IP=172.17.0.1 is docker0 host bridge, unreachable from Compose bridge — fix to hostname 'gateway' (str0m resolves via DNS); (3) TURN_EXTERNAL_IP same issue — fix coturn entrypoint to shell-expand hostname -i. Plan: 2-3 changes, G3 fix + CI re-run + flip.
